messages.subject: 2d error representation on scatterplot
parts:
I am comparing two continuous variables in a scatterplot, to see how the relationship between them changes as a result of two different factors. In my real dataset I want to illustrate how the mean of value1 increases with factor1, while the mean of value2 decreases with factor1, while displaying the relationship with factor2 at the same time. For this I need to display error in some way.

The data can be displayed as a faceted scatterplot:

w <- data.frame("value1" = c(2:5)+rnorm(480), "value2" = c(5:2)+rnorm(480), "factor1" = as.factor(rep(1:4,120)), "factor2" = as.factor(rep(rep(1:3,each=4),40)))
p <- ggplot(w, aes(value1, value2))
f <- facet_grid(factor1 ~ factor2)
p + f + geom_point()

I am not sure how best to illustrate the means and error values on this though. I can display the range of either value individually with a boxplot:
p + f + geom_boxplot() + geom_point(colour = "red")

However I need to display both, and would prefer to just present means and sem. Two crossed error bars would do the job (a rangefinder plot), or I could use something more specific like a bagplot. However I can't figure out how to create these in ggplot2. And I may well be going about this the wrong way anyway, there could be a much simpler way of displaying this data I haven't thought of.

Any suggestions would be appreciated.

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: 2d error representation on scatterplot
parts:
Hi:

Here's my take:

w <- data.frame(value1 = c(2:5)+ rnorm(480),

value2 = c(5:2)+rnorm(480),
factor1 = as.factor(rep(1:4,120)),
factor2 = as.factor(rep(rep(1:3,each=4),40)))
p <- ggplot(w, aes(value1, value2))
f <- facet_grid(factor1 ~ factor2)
p + f + geom_point()

## Generate means and SDs for value1 and value2
summfun <- function(d) data.frame(v1mean = mean(d$value1), v1sd = sd(d$value1),
v2mean = mean(d$value2), v2sd = sd(d$value2))
## Generate a data frame of such summaries for all factor combinations
wsumm <- ddply(w, .(factor1, factor2), summfun)

ggplot() + geom_point(data = w, aes(x = value1, y = value2)) +
facet_grid(factor1 ~ factor2) +
geom_errorbar(data = wsumm,
aes(x = v1mean, ymin = v2mean - v2sd, ymax = v2mean + v2sd),
color = 'red', size = 1, width = 0.2) +
geom_errorbarh(data = wsumm,
aes(x = v1mean, y = v2mean, xmin = v1mean - v1sd,
xmax = v1mean + v1sd),
color = 'blue', size = 1, width = 0.2)

If you want CI bars, change the scale factor on x/ymin and x/ymax. Of
course, feel free to change the other arguments to your needs.

HTH,
Dennis
